description: Generated a discovery question asking Xero which AI tool their employees use — but the Infrastructure & Setup Guide and Xero's Anthropic partnership confirm Claude is the tool. Also left 'Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude, other?' language in the infrastructure section. Multiple references treated the AI tool as unknown when it was confirmed.
correction: All references to unknown AI tool selection replaced with Claude-specific language. Discovery question asking about tool choice removed. Infrastructure section updated to ask about Claude access and Anthropic endpoint availability specifically.
